_comment: Per-PR demo for #1348 / #1178 line_relief corridor. The right-click MUST land after the enemy reaches the tired unit (contact is ~tick 128) -- a right-click on a friendly that is not yet FIGHTING resolves to a plain ground MOVE, not a RELIEF, and the corridor code then never runs at all.
caption: Line relief corridor: at tick 200 the fresh Infantry (uid1) takes a RELIEF order on its engaged ally (uid0), which peels back on a MOVE. While the link is live the reliever's block widens -- its median soldier spacing rises from 9.00 to 10.05 wu as it closes -- so it passes through without intra-unit overlap. The tired unit's own peel-back does NOT yet hold formation: see the PR thread for the measured numbers.
